findings.title: Secret owners lack explicit lifetime endings
findings.reproduction: Read the cited ownership/call trace; run the named isolated probe where applicable.
findings.observed: Five representative owners have no wipe/dispose. Fifteen of16Redacted classes lack wipe; these are leads, not15 separate security defects. Frozen indexes and retained passphrase strings have no explicit lifetime end.
findings.impact: Bounded lifetime/interface/maintainability gap. No external leak, wrong deterministic wallet result or release exploit established.
findings.recommendedFix: Use owned mutable secret storage and explicit wipe/dispose; migrate owning callers/hosts and classify borrowed wrappers separately.
findings.requiredVerification: Lifetime/disposal/refusal tests, original vectors, host cleanup and input-copy boundaries.
evidence: Source trace independently reviewed and challenged against existing owners/counterexamples

findings.title: Word table and coin capabilities lack granular package entries
findings.reproduction: Read the cited ownership/call trace; run the named isolated probe where applicable.
findings.observed: Word-table capability reaches package consumers through aggregate root, which links Node crypto and file/render modules. Coins have standalone source families but only the all-family registry package entry. Existing granular entries and source vendoring work.
findings.impact: Bounded lifetime/interface/maintainability gap. No external leak, wrong deterministic wallet result or release exploit established.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a cohesive WordTable owner/entry and granular existing coin-family/composition exports. Keep legacy root adapters while migrating callers; no thin class per helper.
findings.requiredVerification: Browser-safe package imports, no eager all-coin graph, exact outputs and compatible host adaptation.
evidence: Source trace independently reviewed and challenged against existing owners/counterexamples

findings.title: SSKR consumers require unused host capabilities
findings.reproduction: Read the cited ownership/call trace; run the named isolated probe where applicable.
findings.observed: Recovery demands full SharePlatform though it only combines; repair also demands createShares. Existing fake supplies a throwing no-split stub. Dependencies are already injected, so no global-platform allegation.
findings.impact: Bounded lifetime/interface/maintainability gap. No external leak, wrong deterministic wallet result or release exploit established.
findings.recommendedFix: Narrow each operation to needed capabilities while retaining complete host-platform composition.
findings.requiredVerification: Combine-only/repair-only typechecks and real split/repair/restore controls.
evidence: Source trace independently reviewed and challenged against existing owners/counterexamples

findings.title: Backup option forwarding adds unnecessary coupling
findings.reproduction: Read the cited ownership/call trace; run the named isolated probe where applicable.
findings.observed: Several public functions only forward to Masking/EncodedForm, yet callers acquire a backup-options to SSKR split graph. ShareSetChoice and actual form-to-share mapping remain substantive.
findings.impact: Bounded lifetime/interface/maintainability gap. No external leak, wrong deterministic wallet result or release exploit established.
findings.recommendedFix: Use existing owners directly and expose EncodedForm separately; preserve real ShareSetChoice behavior and compatibility adapters.
findings.requiredVerification: Options/encoding regressions, import graph and narrow host entry checks.
evidence: Source trace independently reviewed and challenged against existing owners/counterexamples

findings.title: Coin readers retain mutable configuration aliases
findings.reproduction: Read the cited ownership/call trace; run the named isolated probe where applicable.
findings.observed: Base58Coin retains the caller version array and nested prefixes. Coin identity/path fields are only TypeScript-readonly. Main direct risk is custom host configuration; built-in descriptions normally lack external aliases.
findings.impact: Bounded lifetime/interface/maintainability gap. No external leak, wrong deterministic wallet result or release exploit established.
findings.recommendedFix: Snapshot version records/prefixes and stabilize identity/path properties behind private storage/getters.
findings.requiredVerification: Mutable/getter config and identity stability regressions, plus existing exact address/path vectors.
evidence: Source trace independently reviewed and challenged against existing owners/counterexamples

findings.title: Search timing depends on a global clock
findings.reproduction: Read the cited ownership/call trace; run the named isolated probe where applicable.
findings.observed: SearchRun injects scheduler and cancellation but timing uses performance.now globally. Current tests replace that global. This is a dependency/testability gap, not a browser availability defect.
findings.impact: Bounded lifetime/interface/maintainability gap. No external leak, wrong deterministic wallet result or release exploit established.
findings.recommendedFix: Inject an optional monotonic clock through search run and pace/turn owners, preserving the existing default.
findings.requiredVerification: Fake-clock boundaries, timing estimates, cancellation and ordinary host behavior.
evidence: Source trace independently reviewed and challenged against existing owners/counterexamples

findings.title: SSKR export policy is duplicated across CLI and library
findings.reproduction: Read the cited ownership/call trace; run the named isolated probe where applicable.
findings.observed: CLI and ShareRestore.repair separately select per-share repair after too-few, variants without saving, and single-set export. Low-level rules are shared; interactive prompts/re-reading legitimately stay in CLI.
findings.impact: Bounded lifetime/interface/maintainability gap. No external leak, wrong deterministic wallet result or release exploit established.
findings.recommendedFix: Extract one library outcome decision usable by interactive and noninteractive restoration; retain CLI questions/retries/fresh reads.
findings.requiredVerification: Too-few, intact, repaired, multiple-set, wallet and cancelled cases through both front ends.
evidence: Source trace independently reviewed and challenged against existing owners/counterexamples

findings.title: Release helper still throws cancellation
findings.reproduction: Read the cited ownership/call trace; run the named isolated probe where applicable.
findings.observed: Isolated actual pre-child run rejects with Cancelled and no code; catch distinguishes it with instanceof. Zero children/signatures/publish operations ran. Ordinary CLI cancellation migration did not cover this helper.
findings.impact: Bounded lifetime/interface/maintainability gap. No external leak, wrong deterministic wallet result or release exploit established.
findings.recommendedFix: Return a cancellation outcome throughout the helper, retaining exit130 and stopping before later steps.
findings.requiredVerification: Safe fake-child pre-start/interrupted checks, one cancellation message, no later step; no real release action.
evidence: Source trace independently reviewed and challenged against existing owners/counterexamples

remediation.evidence: Current producer owner variants verified at the 607-file AUD-031 remediation snapshot; see currentVerification and AUD-031 dated follow-up. Prior dynamic row retained; external host/release acceptance remains separate.

WordTable owns lookup/export; standalone package entries expose it, EncodedForm, CoinList/Base58Coin, coin families and self-tests. Legacy wrappers preserve values and codes. Worktree after signed checkpoint 0d7898fed2efc4af59b2bff91b0da77d1f99315f.

SSKR restore/repair/split consumers accept ShareCombiner/ShareRepairPlatform/ShareSplitPlatform; no throwing no-split stub is needed. Worktree after signed checkpoint 0d7898fed2efc4af59b2bff91b0da77d1f99315f.

Internal callers use EncodedForm/Masking owners directly; backup-options retains substantive ShareSetChoice/mirroring and compatibility adapters. Worktree after signed checkpoint 0d7898fed2efc4af59b2bff91b0da77d1f99315f.

Base58 version records/prefixes are owned snapshots; Coin identity/path properties have private storage and getter-only access. Worktree after signed checkpoint 0d7898fed2efc4af59b2bff91b0da77d1f99315f.

SearchRun.now and optional timing parameters supply a monotonic millisecond clock, forwarded through nested code/date/share searches; default unchanged. Worktree after signed checkpoint 0d7898fed2efc4af59b2bff91b0da77d1f99315f.

ShareRestore.exportDecision is shared by library repair and interactive export; fresh input reads/questions remain in the CLI. Worktree after signed checkpoint 0d7898fed2efc4af59b2bff91b0da77d1f99315f.

Release helper returns CANCELLED through every step, keeps exit130/one message and stops before later steps; real release tools never ran in verification. Worktree after signed checkpoint 0d7898fed2efc4af59b2bff91b0da77d1f99315f.
